CMYK PDF export dependencies, loaded only when printing a seating chart or name list.

jsPDF 4.2.1, MIT
https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspdf/v/4.2.1
svg2pdf.js 2.9.0, MIT
https://www.npmjs.com/package/svg2pdf.js/v/2.9.0
lcms-wasm 1.0.5, MIT, containing Little CMS 2.16, MIT
https://www.npmjs.com/package/lcms-wasm/v/1.0.5

The original distribution files are unmodified. License notices are included here.
The CMYK image plug-in and color conversion are in js/seats/cmyk-pdf.js.
No Ghostscript or other AGPL program is shipped.

Print fonts and the unmodified FOGRA39L Coated profile are in assets/print,
with their original license notices. The profile is from the TeX colorprofiles
collection, generated by Peter Selinger from the public FOGRA39 characterization.
https://github.com/norbusan/colorprofiles
